marker: # ref_size is the product length measured in the LVS assembly GCA_000009245.1 (AM233362.1) by in silico
# PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. Every marker gives exactly one product.
# THE SOURCE TABLE GIVES PRIMERS ONLY, and all eleven loci now call. For ten of them the unit and the
# copy number are taken from the bundled scheme francisella_johansson_2004, which counts the same arrays
# and carries the published SCHU S4 copy numbers of Johansson et al. 2004 Table 2. The eleventh,
# Ft-M20B, is called from a bins table, bins.tsv, under a convention of this scheme, described below.
# The copy number of the ten comes from calibrating through SCHU S4: the array a locus contains is the
# same DNA whichever primers flank it, so this scheme's SCHU S4 product minus the array the Johansson
# scheme counts there gives this scheme's flank, which fixes the copy number in LVS.
#   locus    Johansson locus, unit and SCHU S4 count   flank   LVS count
#   Ft-M02   Ft-M2    6 bp   4 copies                    327     2
#   Ft-M03   Ft-M3    9 bp  25 copies                    209    16
#   Ft-M04   Ft-M4    5 bp   3 copies                    202     4
#   Ft-M05   Ft-M5   16 bp   3 copies                    268     2
#   Ft-M06   Ft-M6   21 bp   4 copies                    188     4
#   Ft-M10   Ft-M10  16 bp  18 copies                    166     2
#   Ft-M20A  Ft-M20  12 bp   3 copies                    271     4
#   Ft-M22   Ft-M22   6 bp   2 copies                    154     4
#   Ft-M23   Ft-M23  23 bp   2 copies                    304     1
#   Ft-M24   Ft-M24  21 bp   1 copy                      375     2
# The calibration was tested on 22 Francisella genomes, whose identity was read from the assembly
# headers: nine subspecies tularensis, three holarctica, one mediasiatica and nine novicida. Every flank
# yields a whole number of repeats in LVS. And because both schemes count the same array, their alleles
# must agree for any strain, which they do: at the nine loci other than Ft-M20, all 112 comparisons in
# the 13 genomes outside novicida and all 33 in novicida give the same allele. At Ft-M20 they differ in
# 3 of 13 and in 9 of 9, and that is expected, since Johansson amplifies Ft-M20 as one product and the
# insertion that Vogler split off into Ft-M20B lengthens it in the genomes that carry the insertion.
# The scale is the published Johansson one, so the two Francisella schemes are consistent.
# The units were also checked by the cross strain rule, that a locus keeps one flank so its products
# differ by whole multiples of the unit. In the 13 genomes outside novicida eight of the ten calibrated
# loci obey it, Ft-M02, M03, M04, M05, M06, M10, M20A and M23. Ft-M22 and Ft-M24 do not: their steps are
# 19 bp, and 5 and 16 bp, which point to indels in the flank rather than a different unit, so some
# strains give a fractional allele there and it is flagged INTERMEDIATE and not rounded. The reference
# call is a whole number at every locus.
# Ft-M20B. Vogler et al. split the Johansson Ft-M20 locus into Ft-M20A, the original 12 bp repeat, and
# Ft-M20B, a roughly 200 bp insertion carrying a separate 15 bp repeat, present in type A.II and
# novicida isolates. No publication gives an Ft-M20B copy number, so the scheme defines one.
# The 15 bp unit is confirmed by the data. In the 22 genomes the insertion-bearing products are 351,
# 366, 381, 396 and 411 bp, five sizes in steps of exactly 15 bp, with the same 106 bp left flank and
# 200 bp right flank throughout, apart from point differences between strains. The 12 bp that
# Myrtennas et al. 2020 list for Ft-M20B is not supported; their table gives Ft-M20A the same 12 bp and
# appears to carry the Ft-M20 unit across to both assays.
# LVS and the other 153 bp strains have no insertion and so no array. An earlier note here said the
# 153 bp product held one copy of the unit; that was wrong, because the 15 bp sequence counted lies
# inside the forward primer itself. The 153 bp state is allele 0. It is not on the 15 bp ladder, since
# it differs from 351 bp by 198 bp, which is not a multiple of 15, so the repeat formula cannot link the
# two and Ft-M20B carries no ref_repeats. Alleles come from bins.tsv, 0 at 153 bp and (size - 306) / 15
# above it, 3 to 7 at the five sizes seen, and an unlisted size is reported OFF_TABLE. Each array is a
# diverged lead block, n - 2 exact copies of GACCAAGGTAATAAT and a diverged terminal block, so counting
# the exact copies alone would give 1 to 5, two lower than the allele here. The scale is a convention of
# this scheme and is not published.
# Later studies add nothing to the count. Myrtennas et al. 2020 (Microorganisms 8:1784) and Shevtsov et
# al. 2024 (Pathogens 13:581) find Ft-M20B invariable in their holarctica and mediasiatica strains, and
# the Spanish genomes give 153 bp throughout, as the 153 bp ref_size here does.
# THE LOCUS NAMES OF THE TWO SCHEMES DIFFER ONLY IN SPELLING. This scheme pads the number, Ft-M02,
# where francisella_johansson_2004 does not, Ft-M2, and the allele agreement above confirms the padded
# and unpadded names are the same VNTR. Ft-M20 there is split here into Ft-M20A and Ft-M20B. The two
# still amplify different fragments, so their product sizes are not comparable even though their
# alleles are.
